hypothesis: A bounded source-withdrawal certificate can preserve non-monotone temporal decisions by retaining the records read during execution, including false guards, and branching only on withdrawals that can change those reads.
contract: Supplied structured records, deterministic bounded Boolean programs, and an explicit finite set of (valid-time, known-time) snapshots. A slot returns the eligible record with maximum (valid-from, recorded-at, ordinal); validity is half-open. Withdrawing any source invalidates a jointly attributed record. Preserve both Boolean outputs and the ordered slot/head-identity read trace for every withdrawal of at most k sources. Contradictory claims use separate slots and can both remain supported. This experimental replacement policy is not the shipping default or natural-language extraction.
candidate: Evaluate each snapshot, retain every head record read, recurse on sources in those heads to depth k, memoize withdrawn sets, and union the original records. Empty reads stay empty under further withdrawal. False guards must be retained. Programs and snapshot/budget metadata are included in the packet.
controls: Indexed full history restricted to statically reachable slots and declared snapshots
Per-slot counterfactual head union, constructed by branching on each current head's sources (strong temporal control)
Exhaustive execution-trace union, used only as an independent correctness oracle
Positive-record-only branching, an intentionally unsound negative control
generation: Tiny exhaustive cases enumerate all four values and singleton source assignments on two two-revision slots. Random cases choose slots, three-valued observations, valid/recorded times, optional expiry and one/two-source supports independently from their fixed seed. Larger cases have three true guard slots, two independently valued positive/negative claim slots and 24 alternative slots with six revisions each. Guard provenance is sources 1/2/3 independently, or each of those jointly with the last source. Each conditional query chooses a claim slot when any guard holds, otherwise its own alternative slot. The unconditional regime reads every slot. All history values and single/joint dependencies are generated from the same declared seed; no compiler sees hidden generator state.
screen: Zero output, trace, or original-record mismatches in all cases and all admissible withdrawals. Candidate must be byte-identical to exhaustive trace union. Negative control must fail the hand-constructed false-guard resurrection case. A size lead requires at least 30% smaller canonical JSON packet than the smaller positive temporal control in every independent-guards and joint-guards cohort cell. Unconditional cells are a mandatory disclosed stress regime. Do not claim token, whole-process memory, QA, or system throughput gains from packet bytes.
limits: Local standard library, at most 4096 input records, 256 slots, 256 distinct sources, two source dependencies per record, budget 0..3, 32 snapshots, 32 programs each at most 256 nodes/depth16. Refuse more than 100000 oracle nodes. No paid calls, serving changes, held-out performance data, or remote-soak changes.
priorArt: Dynamic program slicing and dependency provenance already account for control dependencies; why-not provenance and incremental maintenance already handle negation. This experiment tests a concrete bounded-withdrawal composition and its temporal failure modes. It is not a priority claim or proof of superiority over general knowledge compilation. A positive size screen only justifies comparison with query-specialized symbolic compilation and a real reader workload.
